title: Bound every single co-endpoint helper constraint on the paired BIT word
body:
## Result

Impose one nonzero XOR constraint on helpers with the same source and destination charts in the paired 111-port BIT tape. Keep the clocks and normalized payloads of surviving MOVEs. Allow arbitrary subsets of paid deletions and grant each receiver free XOR access to its entire history. For every such constraint and 3/4 ≤ t ≤ 1, the productive credit lost exceeds the maximum saving.

For the 391 rank-eight helpers, a flag of affine cosets covers all 2^391 − 1 hyperplanes. Exactly 549 permit two deletions. The sharp maximum saving is 1 + 4^t versus lost credit 8^t, already strictly unfavorable for 2/3 < t ≤ 1. For the other 17 helpers, all 24 rank-four constraints within the ten equal-endpoint classes save at most 1 + 2^t against 4^t. The helper-625 positive control performs an actual rank-four plus rank-one deletion on live owners and reconstructs every normalized output on its stated subspace.

## Scope and validation

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Source #8027 at fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4, retained by #8035 at ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9. The graph SHA-256 is 74e93daf2b7acf794ffb51f92f03f51556f68126d41ee13a8969bddb4cbe6326. #8034 covers ordered support billing. This proof allows linear cancellation and multiple deletions on one helper hyperplane. #8036 analyzes a particular timed chart and its two-residual rewrite. #7459 studies geometric hyperplanes on a different object.

Ran on CPython 3.12 from the pinned base:

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bit-helper-hyperplanes
```

The registered replay passed the 39,600-instruction source, rank-eight flag and disjointness checks, 24 rank-four cases, the live-owner positive control and a corrupted-source control. The finite classification and the inequalities are in PROOF.md. Changed surviving payloads, different endpoint classes, two simultaneous constraints and tensor correlations remain open. A profitable change would also require a complete physical caller and both signed supplier invoices. This package establishes a scoped obstruction with no change to the achievable κ.

Ali Romman supplied the literal word and physical binding. The retained notices credit the predecessors. Clear1nsight prepared the proof and verifier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
